title: Competition and Consumer Amendment (Continuing ACCC Monitoring of Domestic Airline Competition) Bill 2023
short_title: Competition and Consumer Amendment (Continuing ACCC Monitoring of Domestic Airline Competition) Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would make the competition watchdog keep watching domestic airline prices, costs and profits.
It would order the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission to issue a report every three months and put it online.
The monitoring would start the day after the bill becomes law.
changes: The bill extends the ACCC's monitoring of domestic air passenger services.
It requires quarterly public reports from the ACCC.
It directs the minister to table each report in Parliament.
summary.affected: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission, domestic airlines and their passengers.
